heading: The Complete Restoration company
subheading: A professional and comprehensive service for the restoration of period buildings
introHtml: The Complete Restoration Company are award winning experts in the field of building restoration and conservation. Our high quality work can be seen all over Hertfordshire and London.
lead: The Complete Restoration Company brings period beauty back to life, making sure each project or item fits perfectly for contemporary or traditional living and design.
bodyHtml:
From floor restoration to shot blasting, we use a wide range of techniques to undertake a broad range of restoration work on all types of building restoration and architectural features.

Take a look at our website and discover the type of work we undertake and some examples of work we’ve done in the past. If you’ve got a specific project that you would like advice on or help with, then please feel free to get in touch
